Due to favourable weather condition there may be seen swarming caterpillar
in the Sali rice field. To control the pest apply Fipronil 5 SC @1.5 to 2ml/lit
of water in the clear weather condition only. Farmers are advised to take the
advantages of fair weather condition by top dressing of Urea @ 4.5 kg/bigha
at tillering stage in Sali rice field. Before fertilizer application, go for
wedding by paddy weeder.

For Rabi maize optimum time of sowing is mid of September to mid of
October. Therefore, farmers are suggested to select hybrid or composite
variety for cultivation. Well drained sandy loam soil is most preferable for
maize cultivation. Plough the field thoroughly to obtain deep, fine and firm
tilth. Laddering should be done properly for leveling a well as to conserve
soil moisture.

Those farmers who had sown the seeds of winter vegetable in the nursery bed
are suggested to monitor the seed beds as most important disease in the
nursery bed is the damping off. Young seedling shows a rot in the crown, later
the tissue become soft and constricted which lead the seedling wilt and fall
over. To manage the diseases, use soil solarization in the nursery bed. Moist
the prepared nursery bed then cover with white plastic (250-300 gauge) so
that it is air tight for up to 21 days. After that remove the plastic and leave the
bed for up to 3 days. Secondly, if symptoms of damping off appear, then
spray Azoxystrobin @ 0.4 gm/liter of water or Trifloxystrobin in nursery
seedling @ 0.6 gm/litter of water.

Due to sufficient moisture in the soil and no heavy rainfall is predicted for the
coming week therefore sowing of seeds of early cauliflower varieties may be
continued. The recommended early varieties are Early Kunwari, Pusa Dipali,
Pusa Katki etc. To transplant one bigha of land sows 85 gram seeds in the
seedbed. Suitable protection like (bamboo net or polyethene cover) may be
given to protect the seedbed from rain.

Those farmers who are interested for sowing of early radish variety seed in
the field are suggested to sow the seed in the main field as there is no chance
of heavy rainfall for the coming five days. Moreover, land should be prepared
to a fine tilth and FYM to be applied.

During the rainy season fowl pox is a major problem in poultry. Healthy bird
should be vaccinated within age of 6th to 10th week in wing web of birds to
provide them lifetime immunity. Isolate or cull infected birds from the flock.
Also, get rid of the stagnant water around the farm to control the vectors like
mosquitoes.
